column1: # Scope: the committed tree at HEAD (`git archive`), 5796 files.
# MEASURED 2026-08-04 with gitleaks 8.30.1 and this repository's
# .gitleaks.toml. 56 findings. EVERY ONE WAS OPENED AND READ before it was
# written down here, and NONE is a live credential. The reason column below is
# per-row, not a blanket category, so a reviewer can disagree with any single
#   41  secureprompt-chat/**   the vendored LibreChat fork — its own test
#                              Third-party code we carry, not code written
#                              here. A fork sync that adds a new one will fail
#                              this gate, which is the correct moment to look.
#    2  secureprompt-ml/       the GLiNER probe corpus and a monkeypatched
#                              chart series key that generic-api-key matched.
# THE ONE WORTH A SECOND LOOK, and it is booked as a follow-up rather than
# verbatim transcript of a 2FA enrolment against a LOCAL dev instance — port
# admin-2fa-demo@example.com. It therefore contains a real TOTP secret, real
# backup codes and real refresh tokens FOR THAT THROWAWAY LOCAL ACCOUNT. The
# JWT's own `exp` is 1784719615, long past. Nothing here authenticates to any
# deployed system. It is still poor hygiene to keep live-shaped session
#   FOLLOW-UP WS6-2-FU3: redact that transcript's token bodies to
#   `<redacted>`; the document's argument does not depend on their values.
#   Delete the seven rows here in the same commit.
# NOT gitleaks' own `file:rule:line` fingerprint — line numbers move whenever
# anything above them is edited, so that key would go stale on unrelated
# changes and make this gate flaky by construction.
# Fails in BOTH directions, like scripts/ci/fmt-gate.sh:
#   * a finding NOT in this file  -> FAIL. New secret, or an old fixture moved
#   * a row here that matches nothing -> FAIL. Delete it; the list must shrink.
# NOTE ON THE THIRD COLUMN: it is a hash of the secret, not the secret. Adding
# a row does not put the value back into the repository.
